description.value: Italia Bella Bar & Grill is a full-service Italian restaurant on Vancouver's Broadway corridor, helmed by owner and executive chef Kam Khinda whose Italian culinary training shapes a menu of homemade pastas, grilled meats, seafood, and pizzas. The restaurant positions itself as a neighbourhood gathering place with a warm atmosphere and locally sourced ingredients where possible. Online ordering and group dining options are available, making it a practical stop for a sit-down meal on a city cycling route.
